name: Key Windows Event IDs for SIEM Monitoring
description: High-value Windows Security event IDs used by SOC analysts in SIEM queries, dashboards, and detection rules. Covers authentication, account management, privilege use, and lateral movement.
source: CDSA Module 02: Security Monitoring & SIEM Fundamentals
notes:
=== Authentication ===
4624  Successful logon (check LogonType)
4625  Failed logon (check SubStatus for reason)
4634  Logoff
4647  User-initiated logoff
4648  Logon using explicit credentials (RunAs, PTH)
4672  Special privileges assigned at logon (admin)

Logon Types (field: winlog.logon.type):
  2  = Interactive (local keyboard)
  3  = Network (file share, net use)
  4  = Batch (scheduled task)
  5  = Service
  7  = Unlock
  8  = NetworkCleartext (IIS basic auth)
  9  = NewCredentials (RunAs /netonly)
  10 = RemoteInteractive (RDP)
  11 = CachedInteractive (cached creds)

4625 SubStatus values:
  0xC0000072 = Account disabled
  0xC000006A = Wrong password
  0xC0000064 = Username doesn't exist
  0xC0000234 = Account locked out
  0xC0000193 = Account expired

=== Account Management ===
4720  New user account created
4722  User account enabled
4723  User changed own password
4724  Admin reset password
4725  User account disabled
4726  User account deleted
4728  Member added to global security group
4729  Member removed from global security group
4732  Member added to local security group
4733  Member removed from local security group
4740  User account locked out
4756  Member added to universal security group

=== Process/Execution ===
4688  New process created (requires audit policy)
4689  Process exited

=== Object Access ===
4663  Attempt to access object (file/folder)
4698  Scheduled task created
4702  Scheduled task updated
5140  Network share object accessed
5145  Network share object checked (SMB)

=== Kerberos ===
4768  TGT requested (Kerberos auth)
4769  Service ticket requested (use to spot Kerberoasting: EncryptionType 0x17=RC4)
4770  Service ticket renewed
4771  Pre-auth failed (Kerberos)

=== System ===
4697  Service installed
7045  New service installed (System log)
4104  PowerShell script block logging
